citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
The facility has not sough veterinary care for two adult budgies. A female adult budgie was observed in a cage with an
adult male. She had a red swollen mass protruding from beneath her tail as observed on the last inspection. A second
bird, a male adult budgie, was seen with a circular patch of feather loss on both eyes. Licensee stated that he was
unaware of what birds he was cited for on the last inspection indicating a continual lack of daily observations. When asked
the licensee stated that he had not communicated with the veterinarian nor has he provided treatment for these birds.
Based on the current condition of these birds there are active issues that require veterinary attention.
Failure to identify changes in animal health and behavior and a lack of communication with the attending veterinarian on
these issues can result in delayed treatment prolonging animal suffering and discomfort. Daily observation must be
performed on all animals to assess their health and well-being and provide treatment as needed. Direct and frequent
communication with the attending veterinarian is required so that timely and accurate information on problems of animal
health can be conveyed to the attending veterinarian. The licensee must seek out veterinary care with their attending
veterinarian.
Correct by close of business day tomorrow, 8/6/2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
Additional Inspectors:
Tomeka Manson, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICER n
